# David Guijosa Infante

> Full-stack developer in Riverside, California, moving into game development.
> This site is a portfolio plus three demo applications that are actually
> running, each with public source.

Also goes by **David Guijosa** and the handle **zntsns**. Builds production web
applications with React, Angular, TypeScript, Java and Spring Boot, PostgreSQL,
Docker and Google Cloud; builds games solo in Unity and C# with assets modelled
in Blender. The links below are live software, not screenshots.

## Live demos

- [Warehouse Receiving](https://www.zntsns.com/warehouse/): a React and TypeScript receiving desk on a real Spring Boot API. Models the awkward cases rather than the happy path — partial deliveries, over-shipments capped at 110%, damaged units that count as received but never reach stock, and JWT-gated clerk and viewer roles. The API runs on Render against Supabase PostgreSQL, so the first request after an idle period is slow.
- [Portal Pantry](https://www.zntsns.com/portal-pantry/): a full-stack food-delivery application with two account roles. Customers browse, order, track and review; store owners run menus, a live order queue, reviews, and server-computed payouts. The hosted demo runs an in-browser mock backend with the same API contract as the Node and SQLite service.
- [Portal Pantry case study](https://www.zntsns.com/portal-pantry/case-study/): how that application was built, presented as a delivery-app session.
- [Simmer](https://www.zntsns.com/simmer/): a recipe finder on TheMealDB — search by name, browse categories, hunt by main ingredient, or shuffle random meals.

## Source

- [ZNTSNS monorepo](https://github.com/Davidzent/ZNTSNS): the portfolio and every demo above, as a pnpm workspace deployed to Firebase Hosting.
- [Warehouse API](https://github.com/Davidzent/Warehouse-API): Java 17, Spring Boot, MyBatis, PostgreSQL. The backend behind the receiving demo.
- [Warehouse UI](https://github.com/Davidzent/Warehouse-UI): read-only mirror of the receiving front end.
- [Simmer](https://github.com/Davidzent/Simmer): read-only mirror of the recipe finder.
- [Portal Pantry](https://github.com/Davidzent/Portal-Pantry): the food-delivery application.
